assessment.answer: The score of 0.536 comes from an annualized net loss of $38.4M against only $6.6M of assets (5th peer percentile), liabilities of 2.71 times assets and a current ratio of 0.47, after the post-merger SPAC trust money did not come through as assets. The filings show the distress is real and probably worse than the band suggests: cash was $35,359 against a monthly burn of about $1.36M, the company was already in default on $1,480,000 of notes payable and on a related-party yen loan, and a health insurance association seized its Japanese bank account on August 10, 2023. Only part of the loss is non-cash (28%), so the score is not an artefact.
moved_by: cash of $35,359 is about 0.03 months of burn at $1.36M per month, and that ignores debt due
default on $1,480,000 of notes payable not paid by their due date
default on the related-party loan: 100,000,000 yen (about $692,185) unpaid after the maturity had already been extended to June 30, 2023
Japanese bank account seized on August 10, 2023 for unpaid health insurance premiums, and A.L.I. Technologies has not paid some accounts payable by their due date
directors paid company payables personally ($102,000 and $210,424 outstanding)
Lind notes have a cross-default on other debt over $100,000 and a default if market cap is below $20,000,000 for 10 days, and the third $1,500,000 tranche needs no Event of Default
two Nasdaq deficiency notices (minimum bid and MVLS), where delisting is itself a Lind event of default
two late 10-Q filings in a row, an auditor change, heavy turnover of management and the board, and a special Funding Committee formed July 18, 2023

reasons.reason: The Lind notes are senior and carry tight default triggers, so the existing defaults and the Nasdaq problems could make them due early and block the third tranche.
reasons.numbers: cross-default over $100,000; market cap below $20,000,000 for 10 consecutive days; third tranche $1,500,000 purchase price
reasons.quote: (r) the Company’s market capitalization is below $20,000,000 for 10 consecutive days

reasons.reason: Going concern doubt and management's own statement that financing has not covered operations.
reasons.numbers: accumulated deficit $65,695,768; loss from continuing operations $18,376,366
reasons.quote: cash generated from financing activities was not sufficient to fund operations

reasons.reason: Nasdaq deficiency notices put the listing at risk, and losing the listing is an event of default under the Lind notes.
reasons.numbers: $1.00 minimum bid, deadline October 17, 2023; MVLS minimum $50,000,000, deadline December 5, 2023
reasons.quote: (n) the Company’s common stock is no longer publicly traded or cease to be listed on the trading market

reasons.reason: Governance strain: two late 10-Qs, an auditor dismissal, and fast turnover of the CEO, COO, CPO and board.
reasons.numbers: Q2 10-Q due August 14, 2023, filed August 21, 2023; Q1 10-Q due May 15, 2023
reasons.quote: This delay principally relates to the fact that the Company was delayed in obtaining and compiling information required to be included in its Form 10-Q

reasons.reason: All fixed assets in Japan were written down to zero, which shows management expects little future cash from the operating business.
reasons.numbers: impairment loss $1,565,853; property and equipment net nil vs $1,390,547
reasons.quote: the Company recognizes impairment loss for all fixed assets in Japan

evidence_against.point: About 28% of the six-month loss is non-cash (stock compensation $3.7M, impairment $1.6M, depreciation and amortization $0.2M), so the cash-adjusted loss is -$13.8M rather than -$19.2M.
The company raised $3,500,000 from Lind in April and May 2023 and expects a third $1,500,000 tranche.
evidence_against.quote: sale of a third Convertible Note in the principal amount of $1,800,000 for a purchase price of $1,500,000

evidence_against.point: A $100 million SEPA with YA could provide equity funding once a registration statement is effective.
evidence_against.quote: The Company is required to have a Registration Statement declared effective by the SEC before it can raise any funds using the SEPA.

evidence_against.point: The Lind notes do not mature until April and May 2025 and bear no regular interest, so there is no large scheduled maturity in the next year unless a default speeds them up.
evidence_against.source: 10-Q, 2023-08-21, Notes to financial statements - convertible notes

evidence_against.point: Half of the related-party loan was repaid by May 22, 2023, and the lender is negotiating rather than suing.
evidence_against.quote: Accordingly, the Company is regarded in default and negotiates the terms with the lender.

evidence_against.point: Total debt is small in dollar terms ($18.0M of liabilities), so a modest raise or a sale could fix the balance sheet, and the company reported no material legal proceedings.
evidence_against.quote: We are not a party to any material ongoing legal or administrative proceedings.

evidence_against.point: Going concern doubt alone is common in this band, and the defaults so far are against small or related-party creditors.
